attributes.text: Stay connected without staring at your screen!
attributes.originalText: Stay connected without staring at your screen!

attributes.text:
When you receive a notification, SpeakThat will read it out to you using a text-to-speech engine.

All processing happens entirely on your device, and you remain fully in control of what gets read.
